competences.description: Attacks all enemies and increases the damage dealt by 30% per harmful effect granted on the enemies. Grants an additional effect on the enemies according to the rune pattern.
Attacks all enemies and decreases one enemy's Attack Bar to 0. Grants an additional effect on the enemies according to the rune pattern.
Attacks all enemies ruthlessly and inflicts damage that ignores all beneficial effects that reduce damage taken.

Attacks all enemies 3 times to remove beneficial effects by 50% chance each and puts them in the oblivion and silence states for 2 turns. Grants an additional effect on the enemies according to the rune pattern.
